For example, filtering tasks by status=in_progress or triage by tag=cli is lost on reload. Filter state should be persisted in URL query parameters so that refreshing preserves the view, and URLs are shareable/bookmarkable.\n\n**Where**: The tasks page (`packages/web-ui/src/routes/tasks/+page.svelte`) already partially implements URL-based filters — it reads from `$page.url.searchParams` (line 39-47) via the `filterParams` derived value. However, the triage page (`packages/web-ui/src/routes/triage/+page.svelte`) uses local `$state` variables (`filterTag`, `filterStatus` at lines 43-44) that are NOT synced to URL params. Other list pages (items, inbox) likely have the same issue.\n\nKey files to update:\n- `packages/web-ui/src/routes/triage/+page.svelte` — filterTag and filterStatus need URL param sync\n- `packages/web-ui/src/routes/items/+page.svelte` — check if filters use URL params\n- Any other list/filter pages under `packages/web-ui/src/routes/`\n\n**How**: Follow the pattern already established in the tasks page:\n1. Read initial filter values from `$page.url.searchParams` (from `$app/stores`)\n2. When a filter changes, use `goto()` (from `$app/navigation`) to update URL params without a full page reload: `goto(\\`?status=\\${filterStatus}&tag=\\${filterTag}\\`, { replaceState: true, keepFocus: true })`\n3. Use `$derived` to compute filter values from URL params (like tasks page does)\n4. This approach gives: URL persistence, back/forward navigation, shareable links\n\nFor the triage page specifically:\n- Replace `let filterTag = $state('')` with reading from `$page.url.searchParams.get('tag')`\n- Replace `let filterStatus = $state('all')` with reading from `$page.url.searchParams.get('status')`\n- Add `goto()` calls when filters change\n\n**Done when**:\n- All list/filter pages read initial state from URL query params\n- Changing a filter updates the URL without full page reload\n- Refreshing the page preserves filter state\n- Browser back/forward navigates between filter states\n- The triage page URL shows filters like `?status=untriaged&tag=cli`",
